name: Yes_Bank
_comment_use_nse: NSE corporate-announcements feed for YESBANK is currently blocked at the Akamai/IP layer from this network (same issue we see with NSE filings for HDFC's FY22/FY23). Disable to skip a guaranteed-failed round-trip on every run.
_comment_sources: TWO sources, both Oracle Sites Cloud SPAs fronted by Akamai. Neither URL is what the engine actually downloads from — they're passed into the adapter as routing hints (the adapter's render_page() dispatches on URL substring). The IP source resolves filenames to direct OCM asset URLs; the PR source generates synthetic PDFs from HTML-body fields (Yes Bank doesn't publish PR PDFs — the press release content lives as HTML inside the OCM item itself). See banks/Yes_Bank/notes.md for the full investigation.
_comment_requires_js: requires_js is irrelevant here — the adapter never lets the engine render either page in a browser (Akamai blocks Chromium, the page shells have no content anchors, and PRs aren't PDFs anyway). Both sources route through adapter.py's render_page().
